backend/main.mo: Main backend actor that includes blob storage mixin and manages checklist submissions with store name, items (with optional photos), and timestamps, storing them by Principal with functions to submit, retrieve individual, and get all submissions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: PDF download button after submission, persistent PDF button until reset, and reset button functionality, all with high confidence and mapped to test IDs REQ-1, REQ-2, and REQ-3.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files describing the neumorphic-styled checklist application with camera capture, PDF generation, and reset functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes, defining neumorphic design system colors for background, foreground, borders, and component states.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with mobile-optimized viewport settings, web app capabilities, and SafeGuard title that loads the React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component with neumorphic-styled header displaying 'SafeGuard' title and subtitle, containing the main ChecklistForm component in a centered layout.
frontend/src/components/CameraCapture.ts: Inline camera component that auto-starts on mount, displays video preview with explicit dimensions, and provides capture, switch camera (mobile only), and close controls using the useCamera hook.
frontend/src/components/ChecklistForm.ts: Main form managing store name, 7 checklist items with checkboxes and per-item camera capture, submission to backend, persistent PDF download button after submission, reset functionality, and disabled editing after submission.
frontend/src/components/NeumorphicButton: Reusable button component with neumorphic raised styling, primary/secondary variants, 44px minimum touch target, and proper disabled state handling.
frontend/src/components/NeumorphicCard.t: Reusable card container component with neumorphic raised shadow styling and rounded corners for consistent layout.
Reusable input field component with neumorphic inset styling, 44px minimum touch target, focus ring, and disabled state support.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query mutation hook for submitting checklist data with photos to the backend actor, converting File objects to ExternalBlob format.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with neumorphic design system variables, custom utility classes for raised/inset/button effects, and mobile-optimized touch interactions.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider wrapper around the main App component.
frontend/src/types/checklist.ts: TypeScript types for checklist items with optional photo blobs and a constant array defining the 7 standard checklist item names.
frontend/src/utils/pdfGenerator.ts: Utility function that generates a printable PDF by opening a new window with formatted HTML containing checklist items, photos as data URLs, and store/timestamp metadata.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the theme with neumorphic color tokens, custom shadows, and OKLCH color space support for the design system.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking three pending feature requests for adding persistent PDF download button, reset functionality, and maintaining download availability until reset.
